text:
maria: quick check — planning to spin up release/1.16 tomorrow morning (09:30 PT). who wants to own creating the branch and seeding the changelog? also need clarity on backport exceptions for infra and sdk bumps. :eyes:

aj: I can take branch creation at 09:30 PT. plan: create branch from origin/main, tag it release/1.16, then open a PR that seeds CHANGELOG under "Unreleased -> 1.16". backport rules: only bugfix/regression/security fixes qualify by default. infra & sdk bumps need an explicit exception and a short justification in the PR.

luke: FWIW, there's one SDK bump in repo tools-sdk that touches generated code — i'd prefer to ship it on main unless it's tiny. if it must be in 1.16, i'll open a separate backport PR and tag it.

maria: thanks aj & luke. for exceptions, is a label enough (backport-exempt)? or do we need explicit approval from release owners?

aj: label + approval from release owner. so workflow: open backport PR -> add label `backport/1.16` or `backport-exempt` -> ping @olivia (release owner) for signoff. after signoff, we can cherry-pick or merge into release/1.16 depending on the change.

release-bot: Reminder: release branch creation checklist:
1) Branch: `git checkout -b release/1.16 origin/main`
2) Seed changelog: `CHANGELOG.md` entry under Unreleased -> 1.16
3) Add release note in PR template and add `release/1.16` label
4) Run quick smoke e2e suite: `./scripts/smoke.sh --quick`

sam: small Q — cutoff for non-exempt changes? last time we did cutoff 24h before RC freeze. are we keeping the same?

aj: let's keep 48h cutoff for normal changes to give time for smoke + perf runs. RC freeze will be 72h after branch creation. so timeline: create branch 09:30 PT Thu -> cutoff for regular changes Thu 09:30 PT Sat (48h) -> RC freeze Mon 09:30 PT (72h). exceptions allowed but must be signed by @olivia.

olivia: fine with that timeline. i'll monitor exceptions. quick note: please add the PR link and short justification in the `release-exceptions` doc (internal wiki) so we have audit trail.

maria: perfect. aj can you paste the exact commands you'll run so others can follow up if needed?

aj: yup — commands i'll run:
```
# create branch
git fetch origin
git checkout -b release/1.16 origin/main
# push branch
git push -u origin release/1.16
# open PR via gh cli
gh pr create --base release/1.16 --head release/1.16 --title "chore(release): seed release/1.16" --body "Seed changelog and release notes"
```

maria: nice. luke — once branch exists, please try the SDK smoke against it and flag any generator diffs.

luke: will do. ETA 2 hours after branch creation.

sam: tagging product folks in case any feature teams want to call out urgent fixes. @product: if you have anything that must land in 1.16, open a backport PR and tag `backport/1.16` by the cutoff.

maria: final checklist for tomorrow morning:
- [aj] create branch + seed changelog (09:30 PT)
- [luke] SDK smoke + generator diff check (within 2h)
- [maria] audit release-exceptions doc and collect approvals
- [olivia] sign off on exceptions
- [release-bot] run quick smoke; post results here

jt: :thumbsup: (tagging as ack)

aj: will post PR link after creation and ping this thread. if anyone wants to pair on the branch creation step, i'm available 09:15 PT.

maria: thanks everyone — leaving this thread open for follow-ups. :shipit:
